$comment: Style Grammar extracted by hand from brasshands.com (studied Oct 2026). Rules only — no marks, logos or client brands are reproduced. All content is fictional.
name: Neo-Industrial

observations: Near-black charcoal ground with fine grain and CRT scanline texture
One loud signal colour (industrial orange) on neutral greys; primaries only inside emblems
Squared techno display face, all caps; monospaced readouts with wide tracking
Information is framed as telemetry: UNIT IDs, STATUS fields, bracketed states, timecodes, coordinates
Corner registration marks, hairline frames, boxed status tags, slash runs, hazard stripes
Dense control-panel modules locked to a fine grid; small type floating in large dark fields
Glow, scanlines and dot-matrix lettering for screen-like moments

grid.$comment: 8px lattice: module 56x64 (7x8 cells), gutter 16 (2 cells), rows 32 (4 cells). Every edge is a lattice line.

surface.$comment: Post-processing applied to the whole poster.
